title: [QUESTION] How is the pdf generated?
body:
### Issue Details

Hello,
I have a quick question / clarification to understand how the pdf is generated? I see the code where the latex snippet is sent to an external endpoint /generate-pdf.  
Is it possible to share what code is run here? Is there a similar open source repo for that code that I am missing?

Thank you in advance

### Additional Context

_No response_
author: devtanna

comments.body:
hey @devtanna, so there is backend service which we have create and is running on AWS, which requires these packages
```
texlive-latex-base \
    texlive-latex-recommended \
    texlive-fonts-recommended \
    texlive-fonts-extra \
    texlive-latex-extra \
    texlive-xetex \
    texlive-luatex \
    poppler-utils \
    ghostscript \
```, 

That code is not open-sourced right now but we are okay to share that with anyone who needs to look into it

oh wow, thank you for the fast reply! This really helps to understand the packages that are needed!
yes if that's not too much of a bother, would be awesome to look into the backend code. feel free to DM me on dev.tanna@gmail.com 

But I have to say, pretty impressive frontend handling with those resume images 👍

I have sent you the mail, so closing this issue

Thanks!!
